items.rationale: The fixed unit was damaged by lightning overvoltage (§2.3.3), and at nine metres from the hob it is outside the five-metre exclusion (§2.3.10(c)). Under §§7.1.9–7.1.10, the 7.1 kW upgrade is indemnified only up to the cost of an equivalent 3.5 kW unit, estimated at €1,400 gross using Case 38; no deductible is stated.

Sections 7.1.9(c) and 7.1.10 cover ordinary removal, installation, connection and commissioning at the pre-loss specification, not extra labour attributable to the upgrade. Case 38 supports €478 gross for equivalent installation.
Sections 3.5(d) and 7.1.10 exclude the entire console because it was chosen for appearance and was not required for installation. The positive figure is a conditional estimate only.
Sections 7.1.9(e) and 7.1.11–7.1.12 allow ordinary carriage for the covered equivalent unit, not any extra cost attributable to the upgrade or timed service. Case 38 supports €42 gross.

Section 7.1.12 excludes expedited or timed delivery surcharges unless agreed in advance or necessary to avert or mitigate further loss; neither is shown. The positive figure is a conditional estimate only.
Section 7.1.8(b) excludes separately billed administration and processing charges as contractor overhead. The positive figure is a conditional estimate only.
